scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules client/.next server/node_modules server/dist
